==Summary==
:{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}

[[Rand al'Thor|Rand]] and the others are being brought to see the [[The Council of Elders|Elders]] of [[Stedding Tsofu|''Stedding'' Tsofu]]. Rand suggests to [[Loial]] that he wait outside so perhaps the Elders will not dig in to why he is outside while so young.  Loial is still very nervous because all of the girls and women seem to be sizing up as a husband or son-in-law.

[[Alar]], the Eldest, greets them and tells them that [[Verin Mathwin|Verin]] has requested to use the [[Ways|Waygate]] to pursue [[Darkfriend]]s who have stolen the [[Horn of Valere]]. The Elders ask Verin to examine [[Trayal]], an Ogier that traveled the Ways long ago, to demonstrate the risks. She tries, but says he is simply an empty shell. Still, Verin insists that they need to continue via the Ways despite the risks and the Elders reluctantly give their permission. The Elders begin to speak of Loial but Rand cuts in quickly and says that they need him. [[Perrin]], [[Mat]] and even [[Ingtar Shinowa|Ingtar]] all speak on Loial's behalf but finally Verin says flatly that they need him to decipher the Guidings in the Ways, since he has studied them as few Ogier now do. Alar sees that Rand is ''[[ta'veren]]'' and has drawn Loial to him; she agrees to their request but firmly tells them see Loial safely home when their task is complete.

Alar says she will lead them to the Waygate so they can be on their way. Loial is all starry-eyed over a flower [[Erith]] has given him. He finally presses it in the book he is reading. As they leave the ''stedding'' Rand can feel the return of his ability to channel. But when they open the Waygate, ''[[Machin Shin]]'' is still waiting for them.{{ref| It appears that ''Machin Shin'' picked up some of [[Padan Fain]]'s ability to sense and follow Rand.}} They cannot use this Waygate either, so [[Ingtar]] says he will return to [[Cairhien (city)|Cairhien]] and pursue the [[Horn of Valere|Horn]] from there. [[Hurin]] suggests they use a [[Portal Stone]] since they previously saved time traveling with one. Verin says she does not know of any Stones closer than the [[Aiel Waste]]. Rand says he can find the one in [[Kinslayer's Dagger]] although that is still a few days away. Alar says the Stones have not been used since the [[Age of Legends]] and she did not think anyone knew how to use them. Verin says she knows how they are used. Alar says there is a Stone not far from where they are and they go there with haste.
